pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Fall of the Rebel Angels — the bright angels driving the rebels down out of the light into their own shapes, all worshipers of images are put to shame, those who boast in idols
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_beelden

pictures.scene: Albrecht Dürer, The Adoration of the Trinity — the whole company of heaven and earth kneeling around the cross held up by the Father, worship Him all you gods, Zion hears and rejoices
pictures.name: pd_durer_goden

pictures.scene: Salomon van Ruysdael, View of Deventer — the river town with its church tower and windmills standing clear under a wide sky, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_ruysdael_sion

pictures.scene: Domenico Fetti, Salvator Mundi — Christ on the clouds with His hand raised and the globe under His other hand, for You O LORD are Most High over all the earth, You are exalted far above all gods
pictures.name: pd_fetti_hoogste

pictures.scene: Pieter Aertsen, Christ Cleansing the Temple — Christ reaching across the money table and turning the traders out of the courts, hate evil O you who love the LORD, He preserves the souls of His saints
pictures.name: pd_aertsen_kwaad

pictures.scene: Sebastiano Ricci, The Liberation of Saint Peter — the angel taking the sleeping apostle by the wrist and leading him past the guards, He delivers them from the hand of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_ricci_bewaart

pictures.scene: Aelbert Cuyp, Herdsmen with Cows — the herdsmen resting with their cattle in the long golden light of the river bank, light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_licht

pictures.scene: Hendrick Cornelisz van Vliet, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Delft — the great organ standing at the end of the sunlit nave with the people gathered below it, rejoice in the LORD you righteous ones, and praise His holy name
pictures.name: pd_vliet_verblijdt

lines.text: All worshipers of images are put to shame—
and the towns of Judah exult
because of Your judgments, O LORD.
For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth;
You are exalted far above all gods.
Hate evil, O you who love the LORD!
He preserves the souls of His saints;
He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
gladness on the upright in heart.
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones,
